planning.note: An issue whose plan is being written. Shown on the run panel, the Telegram card and the console line.

executing.note: An issue whose plan is being executed. Shown on the run panel, the Telegram card and the console line.

planned.note: An issue that got a plan and was not executed, as in a dry run. Shown on the run panel and the Telegram card.

done.note: An issue that was executed and closed. Shown on the run panel, the Telegram card and the console totals.

skipped.note: An issue the queue did not run, for example because a dependency is open. Shown on the run panel, the Telegram card and the console.

blocked.note: An issue whose execution stopped as blocked. Shown on the run panel, the Telegram card and the console totals.

infeasible.note: An issue whose plan has no step. Shown on the run panel and the Telegram card.

needs_split.note: An issue that holds several tasks and waits for a person to split it. Shown on the run panel, the Telegram card and the console line.

non_green.note: An issue that stopped without a green result for another reason. Shown on the run panel and the Telegram card.

hitl.note: An issue that waits for a person because of a human gate in its dependencies. Shown on the run panel, the Telegram card and the console.

done.note: The execution finished green. Shown on the console line of a finished issue.

blocked.note: The agent reported that it cannot go on. Shown on the console line of a finished issue.

timeout.note: The execution used its whole time budget. Shown on the console line of a finished issue.

stuck.note: The execution stopped without a known outcome. Shown on the console line of a finished issue.

limit.note: The vendor's usage limit stopped the execution. Shown on the console line of a finished issue.
